programmes.d: Criminal lovers Roger Gillett and Lisa Chamberlin visit Roger’s cousin, leading to chaos and a barn full of horrors.
Pregnant mom Tina Young, hooked on heroin, and her ex-con lover Larry Tooley, target a family she once babysat, with fatal results.
Laura Hernandez, a controlling matriarch, convinces her kids to kill her husband, Alberto, seeing him as more valuable dead than alive.
When a young mother goes missing, investigators follow a chilling trail of evidence that leads them back to her own backyard, unraveling a dark secret.
Sadistic Mike Murdaugh and his twisted lover Becky Rohrs brutally torment and eliminate Becky’s admirers, driven by a dangerous and jealous obsession.
Bored with her overprotective parents, Leslie Ballard finds passion with an older man, but when left short in her father’s will, she plots deadly revenge.
A beautiful call girl and a smooth-talking gigolo team up for a deadly crime spree, leaving behind a trail of broken hearts and empty bank accounts.
While most couples enjoy double dates and vacations, these two pairs prefer robbery, torture, and murder as their shared pastime.
Two ex-military men go on a killing spree, bringing terror and murder to popular vacation spots, leaving authorities in a desperate race to stop them.
The trial of OJ Simpson became headline news and divided the nation and the world.
A woman who had been married 10 times, sometimes committing bigamy, goes on trial for murdering her last husband.
Jack and Linda Jones, a Florida couple, seemed to have the perfect life--until Jack turned up dead.

Examines a case that has been traveling through the Virginia criminal justice system for 10 years. In 1993, Merry Pease claimed that her husband shot her, but authorities charged that she killed her husband and then shot herself.

A look at the controversial case of Deputy Sheriff Joseph Kent McGowan, whose dispute with a Texas woman, Susan White, ended up with McGowan shooting White in her bedroom. Two juries found McGowan guilty of murder.
The story of crusading attorney Juliet Yackel and her desperate attempt to save her client, Darnell Williams, whose execution for the double murder of an elderly couple is only one month away.
A look at the case of Farah Frattah, a Texas woman who was murdered after claiming that her husband, Bob, was a sexual deviant and a threat to their children's safety.
Two lovers flee a Federal prison in a hijacked helicopter in Dublin, CA.
Seven criminals break out of a supermax prison in Texas with deadly consequences.
Eight dangerous inmates form an unlikely alliance to escape a temporary detention center.
Alfred "Houdini" Hinds breaks out of prison three times while trying to clear his name.
Six inmates pull off an ill-advised Christmas Eve escape by smashing through a wall behind a rusted toilet.
Two women break their significant others out of prison with a hijacked helicopter in Crowley County, CO.
Rédoine Faïd is infamous for his two audacious prison escapes and his bombastic, charismatic personality.
A correctional officer breaks her inmate boyfriend out of a Maryland prison.
Dog trainer Toby Dorr uses a dog crate to smuggle her new love out of Lansing Correctional Facility.
Hans-Joachim Horn steals a tank and breaks his friend and mentor, Lothar Luft, out of prison.
On August 20, 2001, Charles Tremblay, 15, was beaten, then thrown into the St-Charles River where he drowned. Tremblay's body was discovered in the mud less than 24 hours after his death.

On June 17, 1994, a tugboat operator is towing a log boom down the Fraser River from Port Coquitlam when he notices something caught up on one of the logs. Upon closer inspection, he discovers a human body.
On August 4th, 2008, kayakers found a 40-year-old homeless man, Mark Hanley, floating near the marina in Nanaimo, British Columbia. He had been severely beaten and stabbed.

In the small town of Carleton Place, Ontario, on the morning of November 10th, 1994, Garry Samuels drove himself and his wife, Barbara Lanthier, into the Mississippi River. He escaped but claimed he was unable to save his wife.

On October 1, 2000, 10-year-old Heather Thomas disappeared from her father’s Cloverdale townhouse. Ertmoed is arrested and confesses that he lured Heather into his apartment on the pretext of showing her pictures of birds and strangles her to death.

14-year-old Pamela Bischoff misses her curfew on April 12, 1991. Though she has only been missing a few hours, her mother, Gail, tells the Oromocto RCMP she is certain Pamela has been raped and murdered by an older boy named Billy Stillman.

Jutta Weber is last seen on August 6, 1997. In August 1999, Don Gazley is arrested and wants to cut a deal: if the police make his charges go away, he’ll tell them where Jutta Weber’s body is. Is Gazley telling the truth?
